title: Restore canonical sales stock-out form and server-numbered HTTP entry
description: Make the existing stock-out menu choose its already implemented canonical EF api/stock-outs module and explicit sales-order source selector, with no legacy stored-procedure write adapter or Oid/Id mapping. StockOut.StockOutNo has Required with empty default while Create assigns the server number; allow omitted-number requests through genuine MVC binding, preserve server-owned identity/status and ensure rejected business values consume no number. Keep source ownership, remaining sales-order capacity, inventory sufficiency/cost, approved returns and loading references authoritative. Preserve manual unlinked historical-compatible entry where supported and current document page/drawer behavior. Use self-contained ephemeral JWT configuration in isolated test API processes without reading production settings. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: The authorized stock-out menu opens api/stock-outs with canonical IDs; omitted-number HTTP creation returns a server number, and save/reload/edit main/detail rows and explicit sales-order remaining-capacity selection work through existing current-scope endpoints. Keep manual unlinked entry explicit and legacy history separate.

Valid typed fields and source detail payloads pass existing validation; submit/approve posts outbound stock and cost exactly once in existing transactions. Overdelivery, insufficient inventory, stale/deleted source, unauthorized customer and invalid quantity/amount cases fail atomically before numbering or posting. Existing approved return/loading-reference reversal guards are preserved.

Real isolated SQL/HTTP tests cover binding, round trip, manual and linked source paths, valid posting/reversal and rejected zero inventory/movement/source/number changes. Browser proof must use real permitted API writes or record an actual environment blocker; preserve source-picker tests and safe Release/full unit regressions.
implementation_evidence: bill-v2.js:28 keeps stock-out in the legacy map despite modules-doc2.js:91-110 providing api/stock-outs and stock-out-source selector. app.js dispatches legacy map first and ERP-404 blocks legacy mutation. Logistics.cs:95-96 marks StockOutNo Required with empty default while StockOutController.Create:134 generates StockOutNo. ERP-376 closes source selection but leaves menu dispatch/model binding unreachable.
